info.description: 22 read-only Statistics endpoints (19 JSON reports + CSV/XLSX/PDF exports). Managed capacity uses canonical ManagedCellStock + ManagedItemInstance V4 reconciliation against schema-v4 movement history. Export limits: 1,000 rows, 8 MB, 25 seconds, 2 concurrent requests. Financial exports contain only verified successful PayOS captures; unavailable metrics remain null.
